candidate_structure.period_definition: truncated p: token[i]=token[i-p] for all i>=p; exact tiling additionally requires length divisible by p; p=length always allowed
candidate_structure.two_token_cycle_definition: at least four tokens, minimal truncated period exactly two; a truncated final repetition is allowed
candidate_structure.suffix_definition: longest constant or alternating two-distinct-ID suffix, regardless of prefix; alternating suffix is zero unless at least four tokens; nondividing final repetitions allowed
candidate_structure.whitespace_definition: exact token bytes concatenated, nonempty ASCII whitespace only; null if no decoder supplied
limitations: Structural description, never a filter or corpus match measurement.
Counts include repeated records; distinct_paths separately measures duplication.
Small periods and whitespace runs can yield trivial exact matches, not recovered passages.
Not uniform over Euler trails; not a p-value or calibrated null.
Only tests order beyond pairs, not whether pair associations were learned.
Corpus used only in verification; candidate extraction must be separately audited.
Preserving pairs can force some longer substrings; rigid graphs may remain unchanged.
Nonuniform over Euler trails; not a p-value or calibrated null.
Tests order beyond triples, not whether triple associations were learned.
Corpus is used only in verification; extraction needs its own leakage audit.
Rigid graphs may remain unchanged or force longer matching substrings.
Distinct substring counts select the earliest candidate offset among longest ties.

independent_numerical_audit.reproduction: Run audit_program with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4; all original inputs are read-only and report destination must not exist.
independent_numerical_audit.audit_program:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, sys, time
import numpy as np
from scripts.weight_analysis.checkpoint import GPT2Checkpoint, sha256_file
from scripts.weight_analysis.late_mlp_polynomial import compile_polynomial
from scripts.weight_analysis.late_mlp_paths import array_record, file_record, initial_strings, select_vocabulary, write_exclusive
started=time.monotonic()
root=Path('/tmp/pluto-late-mlp.BibMOA')
plan_path=root/'final_full.jsonl.plan.json'
metadata_path=root/'final_full.jsonl.metadata.json'
candidate_path=root/'final_full.jsonl'
plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text());meta=json.loads(metadata_path.read_text())
candidates=[json.loads(line) for line in candidate_path.read_text().splitlines()]
assert meta['complete'] is True and meta['candidate_count']==64
assert file_record(plan_path)==meta['plan'] and file_record(candidate_path)==meta['candidates']
for name,record in plan['sources'].items():assert file_record(record['path'])==record,name
checkpoint=GPT2Checkpoint(plan['checkpoint']['checkpoint_directory'],check_finite=True)
assert json.loads(json.dumps(checkpoint.provenance(hash_weights=True)))==plan['checkpoint']
selector=GPT2Checkpoint(plan['selection_checkpoint']['checkpoint_directory'],check_finite=True)
assert json.loads(json.dumps(selector.provenance(hash_weights=True)))==plan['selection_checkpoint']
ids,selection=select_vocabulary(selector.token_embedding,8192)
assert np.array_equal(ids,plan['selection']['sorted_ids'])
assert json.loads(json.dumps(selection,default=lambda x:x.tolist()))==plan['selection']
initial=initial_strings(ids,64,16,20260909)
assert np.array_equal(initial,plan['initial_token_ids'])
assert hashlib.sha256(initial.astype('<i4').tobytes()).hexdigest()==plan['initial_ids_sha256']
probe=compile_polynomial(checkpoint,ids,16,mode='full',blocks=(6,7),alpha=.125)
records={name:array_record(getattr(probe,name),'<i8' if name=='token_ids' else '<f8') for name in meta['compiled_arrays']}
assert records==meta['compiled_arrays']==meta['compiled_arrays_after']
final=np.array([r['token_ids'] for r in candidates],dtype=np.int64)
assert np.array_equal(np.array([r['initial_token_ids'] for r in candidates]),initial)
initial_scores=probe.score(initial)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(initial_scores,[r['initial_score'] for r in candidates])
parts=probe.score_components(final)
for name,values in parts.items():
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(values,meta['final_components'][name])
for i,row in enumerate(candidates):
 assert row['score']==parts['total'][i]
 assert row['linear_score']==parts['linear'][i]
 assert row['quadratic_score']==parts['quadratic'][i]
# Independent direct per-prefix accumulation, without the scorer's cumsum.
dense=np.zeros(64)
index={int(token):i for i,token in enumerate(ids)}
for i,row in enumerate(final):
 for r in range(1,16):
  source=[index[int(t)] for t in row[:r]]
  x=.125/r*np.sum(probe.direct[np.arange(r),source],axis=0)
  z=.125/r*np.sum(probe.features[np.arange(r),source],axis=0)
  target=index[int(row[r])]
  dense[i]+=x@probe.readout[target]+(probe.g7*z+.5*probe.h7*z*z)@probe.neuron_readout[target]
np.testing.assert_allclose(dense,parts['total'],atol=1e-10,rtol=5e-10)
rows=initial.copy();previous=initial_scores.copy()
max_trace_error=0.0
trace=meta['optimization_trace'];assert len(trace)==128
for count,step in enumerate(trace):
 sweep=count//16; position=count%16 if sweep%2==0 else 15-count%16
 assert step['sweep']==sweep and step['position']==position
 assert step['direction']==('forward' if sweep%2==0 else 'reverse')
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(previous,step['scores_before'])
 proposed=rows.copy();proposed[:,position]=step['selected_token_ids']
 assert np.all(np.isin(proposed,ids))
 changed=np.flatnonzero(np.any(proposed!=rows,axis=1)).tolist()
 assert changed==step['changed_rows']
 retained=step['roundoff_retained_rows']
 assert len(retained)==len(set(retained)) and all(0<=i<64 and i not in changed for i in retained)
 actual=probe.score(proposed)
 expected=np.asarray(step['scores_after'])
 max_trace_error=max(max_trace_error,float(np.abs(actual-expected).max()))
 np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual,expected)
 assert np.all(actual>=previous)
 rows,previous=proposed,actual
np.testing.assert_array_equal(rows,final)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(previous,parts['total'])
assert json.loads(json.dumps(checkpoint.provenance(hash_weights=True)))==plan['checkpoint']
for name,record in plan['sources'].items():assert file_record(record['path'])==record,name
report={
 'stage':'independent_weight_only_final_full_audit_no_corpus_no_model',
 'plan':file_record(plan_path),'candidates':file_record(candidate_path),'metadata':file_record(metadata_path),
 'audit_environment':{'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':4,'OMP_NUM_THREADS':4,'numpy':np.__version__},
 'checkpoint_weight_hashes_equal':100,'source_records_equal':len(plan['sources']),
 'selected_ids_and_initial_strings_exact':True,'initial_ids_sha256':plan['initial_ids_sha256'],
 'compiled_arrays_exact':records,'candidate_count':64,'distinct_final_candidates':len({tuple(row) for row in final}),
 'initial_scores_exact':True,'final_components_and_scores_exact':True,
 'independent_dense_score_max_absolute_difference':float(np.max(np.abs(dense-parts['total']))),
 'trace_steps':128,'trace_rows_recomputed':128*64,'trace_scores_exact':True,
 'trace_max_absolute_recompute_difference':max_trace_error,
 'recorded_search_max_expansion_replay_difference':max(step['max_score_discrepancy'] for step in trace),
 'trace_monotonic_and_final_ids_exact':True,
 'coordinate_optimization_rerun':False,'corpus_accessed':False,'model_forward_run':False,
 'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started
}
report['reproduction']='Run audit_program with OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4; all original inputs are read-only and report destination must not exist.'
report['audit_program']=PROGRAM_TEXT
write_exclusive(root/'final_full_independent_audit.json',report)
print(json.dumps({key:value for key,value in report.items() if key not in ('audit_program','compiled_arrays_exact')},indent=2))

independent_direct_token_scan.implementation: first-token np.flatnonzero followed by direct shifted-token equality; descending substring length and ascending candidate offset; all matching byte ranges checked against independently decoded vocabulary bytes

numeric_slack.scope: conservative FP64 arithmetic diagnostic, not interval-certified coefficients or contractions

limitations: This is exploratory diagnosis of the already-frozen surrogate; candidates and extraction settings are unchanged.
No candidate-dependent nonlinear activation, model forward, or corpus lookup is performed.
The scalar bound does not validate weight-derived anchors as actual late-layer residual geometry.
Signed neuron errors and signed readout coefficients can cancel; these scalar lower bounds cannot be summed into a total-logit lower bound.
A nonviolation does not establish accurate approximation; the envelope gives only a one-sided sufficient diagnostic.
No analytical decompressor or passage-to-weight storage map was established.
Choice of late layers was informed by corpus-assisted causal validation.
Current corpus partitions do not authenticate historical training membership.
The surrogate omits contextual routing and normalization; scalar diagnostics do not bound total model error.
Duplicates, formatting outputs and all failed matches retain their original denominators.
The later frozen.json is integrity revalidation, not the first pre-corpus timestamp.
